structures.name: Customer Experience Fragmentation Problem
structures.subject: Marketing and sales separation leads to fragmented customer experience

elements.name: Customers do not fragment experience
elements.description: Customers do not distinguish between marketing and sales, viewing all touchpoints as part of a single relationship

evidence.quote: Customers do not distinguish between the two.

elements.name: Org chart driven design
elements.description: Companies design processes around org charts rather than customer reality

evidence.quote: The organizations that design around that reality, rather than around their own organizational charts

elements.name: Separate data sets
elements.description: Marketing and sales operate on separate data sets and systems

evidence.quote: When marketing and sales operate on separate data sets and disconnected systems

elements.name: Fragmentation cost
elements.description: Inconsistent information across teams is the top reason customers switch suppliers

evidence.quote: buyers cite inconsistent information across teams as the top reason for switching suppliers

constraints.statement: Customer experience is a single continuum

evidence.quote: Every touchpoint...is experienced as a part of a single relationship.

structures.name: AI-Driven Integration Transformation
structures.subject: How Agentic AI drives marketing-sales integration

elements.name: Revenue growth concentration
elements.description: Most consistent AI revenue gains concentrated in marketing and sales

evidence.quote: the most consistent revenue gains from AI are concentrated in marketing and sales

elements.name: Execution convergence
elements.description: Execution increasingly spans previously distinct marketing and sales activities

evidence.quote: execution increasingly spanning what were once distinct marketing and sales activities

elements.name: Continuous loops
elements.description: Activities shift from sequential execution to continuous loops

evidence.quote: Activities that once moved sequentially across teams increasingly operate in continuous loops

elements.name: Shared responsibility
elements.description: Marketing and sales share responsibility for pipeline quality, conversion, and customer value

evidence.quote: Marketing and sales increasingly share responsibility for pipeline quality, conversion, and customer value

constraints.statement: Advantage compounds only when both functions use the same data system

evidence.quote: The advantage compounds only when both functions contribute to and draw from the same data system.

structures.name: Closed-Loop Operating Model
structures.subject: How leading organizations design closed-loop marketing-sales systems

elements.name: Single system design
elements.description: Leading organizations redesign marketing and sales as a single system

evidence.quote: the organizations pulling ahead are redesigning marketing and sales as a single system

elements.name: Rethink the work itself
elements.description: Not layering AI onto existing processes, but rethinking the work itself

evidence.quote: Rather than layering AI onto existing processes, they rethink the work itself

elements.name: Technology shift
elements.description: Shared customer data foundation and coordinated systems

evidence.quote: a shared customer data foundation and coordinated systems

elements.name: Organizational shift
elements.description: Shared incentives and metrics measuring full customer journey outcomes

evidence.quote: shared incentives and metrics that measure outcomes across the full customer journey

constraints.statement: Success requires both technology and organizational shifts

conceptualization.description: Article constructs conceptual system around AI-driven marketing-sales integration, from problem (fragmentation) to solution (closed-loop model)

rejected_candidates.reason: Article explicitly rejects linear journeys, stating customer journeys are cyclical and non-linear

evidence.quote: Buying journeys no longer follow a linear path.

rejected_candidates.reason: Article emphasizes human-AI collaboration, not replacement

evidence.quote: Humans and AI agents work together in a closed loop

rejected_candidates.reason: Article explicitly states technology is no longer the constraint; organization and process are

evidence.quote: The technology to build a closed-loop go-to-market system is no longer the constraint.
